title: Don't Wave at the SCARECROW 🌾
description:
My grandpa's pumpkin patch is the only field on our road without a single crow. Every other field is black with them. The neighbor's scarecrow has one living in its hat.

Since June, Grandpa has gone very quiet at dinner. And every night, Grandma carries a plate out to the field.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment WAVE if your grandpa waves at everybody too.
